newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles says World 4 Kids loses money.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles says World 4 Kids loses money.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Tuesday that its World 4 Kids toy chain made an earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) loss of A$8 million in the first quarter of 1996/97 and would continue to make losses through the fiscal year as Coles restructured the division.
"We made a loss of about A$8 million on the EBIT side in the first quarter," Coles Myer chairman Nobby Clark told the company's annual general meeting when asked about the toy chain's performance.
"Yes there will be a continuing loss from World 4 Kids," he said, adding however that the company would be doing everything it could to ensure the losses were not significant.
Clark said Coles would continue to use the World 4 Kids brand, but there would be only six or seven standalone stores although Coles' other department stores may include a World 4 Kids section.
The company currently has 23 World 4 Kids stores.
Clark said some of the current sites would be converted into other Coles Myer stores such as Officeworks or K-Mart.
In 1995/96, World 4 Kids made an EBIT loss of A$35.8 million compared with a A$33 million loss a year earlier.
